Members of the Telangana State Auto Drivers Unions have proposed to organize a dharna at the Transport Commissioner’s Office. Due to this, vehicle movement is slow from Irram Manzil towards VV Statue.
Commuters are advised to expect delays in the area and plan their travel accordingly. 
Please cooperate and drive safely.
#HyderabadTraffic #TrafficAlert #DriveSafe
